name: switch-tabs
title: Switch Tabs
description: Switch opened tabs in any browser
author: water_tear

commands.name: manageServer
commands.title: Manage Server
commands.description: Manage the browser bridge server, watch logs, and import workspaces

preferences.name: openInBackground
preferences.label: Open in Background
preferences.title: Search: Open in Background
preferences.description: If enabled, opening search results will not focus the browser and keep Raycast open.

preferences.name: clearSearchOnEnter
preferences.label: Clear Search on Enter
preferences.title: Search: Clear on New Tab
preferences.description: If enabled, pressing Enter on a web search result will clear the search bar and return to tabs.

preferences.name: clearSearchOnBackground
preferences.label: Clear Search on Background
preferences.title: Search: Clear on Background
preferences.description: If enabled, opening a web search in the background will clear the search bar and return to tabs.

preferences.name: clearSearchOnCurrentTab
preferences.label: Clear Search on Current Tab
preferences.title: Search: Clear on Current Tab
preferences.description: If enabled, opening a web search result in the current tab will clear the search bar and return to tabs.

preferences.name: showWindowFilter
preferences.label: Show Window Filter
preferences.title: Window Filter
preferences.description: Show a dropdown to filter tabs by browser window. Window selection is remembered per browser.

preferences.name: smartWindowNaming
preferences.label: Enable Smart Window Naming
preferences.title: Smart Window Titles
preferences.description: If enabled, windows will be named using active tab titles or domains instead of 'Window 1, 2, 3...'.

preferences.name: includeAllWindows
preferences.label: Include 'All Windows' View
preferences.title: Include 'All Windows' View
preferences.description: If unchecked, the window filter will only show specific windows (Window 1, 2, 3...).

preferences.name: groupByDomain
preferences.label: Group Tabs by Domain
preferences.title: Group Tabs by Domain
preferences.description: Group tabs by their domain name in the normal (expanded) view.

preferences.name: luckyProvider
preferences.title: Lucky Search Provider
preferences.description: Choose which search engine to use for 'I'm Feeling Lucky' searches.

preferences.name: showSearchImages
preferences.label: Show Entity Images
preferences.title: Search: Suggestion Images
preferences.description: Show rich entity images (logos, thumbnails) in search suggestions. ⚠️ May degrade search performance.

preferences.name: sleepingTabIcon
preferences.title: Icon: Sleeping Tab
preferences.description: The Raycast Icon name for 'Sleeping' tabs (e.g. Moon, Waveform, Leaf).

preferences.name: discardedTabIcon
preferences.title: Icon: Discarded Tab
preferences.description: The Raycast Icon name for 'Discarded' tabs (e.g. LivestreamDisabled, Bolt, Snowflake).

preferences.name: pinnedTabIcon
preferences.title: Icon: Pinned Tab
preferences.description: The Raycast Icon name for 'Pinned' tabs (e.g. Pin, PinDisabled).

preferences.name: sleepingTabColor
preferences.title: Color: Sleeping Tab
preferences.description: Hex code (e.g. #FF9F0A) or Raycast color name (e.g. Orange, SecondaryText) for sleeping tabs.

preferences.name: discardedTabColor
preferences.title: Color: Discarded Tab
preferences.description: Hex code or Raycast color name for discarded tabs.

preferences.name: pinnedTabColor
preferences.title: Color: Pinned Tab
preferences.description: Hex code or Raycast color name (e.g. Blue) for pinned tabs.

preferences.name: closeModifier
preferences.title: Close Tab Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for closing a tab

preferences.name: closeKey
preferences.title: Close Tab Key
preferences.description: Key for closing a tab (e.g. enter, d, backspace)

preferences.name: switchModifier
preferences.title: Switch Tab Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for switching to a tab (Default is Enter)

preferences.name: switchKey
preferences.title: Switch Tab Key
preferences.description: Key for switching to a tab (e.g. enter, s)

preferences.name: searchNewModifier
preferences.title: Search: New Tab Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for opening search in a new tab

preferences.name: searchNewKey
preferences.title: Search: New Tab Key
preferences.description: Key for opening search in a new tab (Default Enter)

preferences.name: searchCurrentModifier
preferences.title: Search: Current Tab Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for opening search in the current tab

preferences.name: searchCurrentKey
preferences.title: Search: Current Tab Key
preferences.description: Key for opening search in the current tab (Default Ctrl+Enter)

preferences.name: cycleBrowserModifier
preferences.title: Cycle Browser Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for cycling browser filter

preferences.name: cycleBrowserKey
preferences.title: Cycle Browser Key
preferences.description: Key for cycling browser filter (Default Tab)

preferences.name: cycleWindowModifier
preferences.title: Cycle Window Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for cycling browser window

preferences.name: cycleWindowKey
preferences.title: Cycle Window Key
preferences.description: Key for cycling browser window (Default `)

preferences.name: closeWindowModifier
preferences.title: Close Window Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for closing browser window

preferences.name: closeWindowKey
preferences.title: Close Window Key
preferences.description: Key for closing browser window (Default Ctrl+X)

preferences.name: historyModifier
preferences.title: History View Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for opening/closing the History view

preferences.name: historyKey
preferences.title: History View Key
preferences.description: Key for opening/closing the History view (Default space)

preferences.name: bookmarksModifier
preferences.title: Bookmarks View Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for opening/closing the Bookmarks view

preferences.name: bookmarksKey
preferences.title: Bookmarks View Key
preferences.description: Key for opening/closing the Bookmarks view (Default space)

preferences.name: workspacesModifier
preferences.title: Workspaces View Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for opening/closing the Workspaces view

preferences.name: workspacesKey
preferences.title: Workspaces View Key
preferences.description: Key for opening/closing the Workspaces view (Default ctrl+backspace)

preferences.name: downloadsModifier
preferences.title: Downloads View Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for opening/closing the Downloads view

preferences.name: downloadsKey
preferences.title: Downloads View Key
preferences.description: Key for opening/closing the Downloads view (Default d)

preferences.name: sessionsModifier
preferences.title: Sessions View Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for opening/closing the Sessions view

preferences.name: sessionsKey
preferences.title: Sessions View Key
preferences.description: Key for opening/closing the Sessions view (Default x)

preferences.name: clearSearchModifier
preferences.title: Clear Search Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for clearing search or filter text

preferences.name: clearSearchKey
preferences.title: Clear Search Key
preferences.description: Key to clear search or filter text (Default ')

preferences.name: enableSlashClearInSearch
preferences.label: Enable Clear Search key to clear search text in Search Mode
preferences.description: If enabled, typing the Clear Search key in Search Mode when there is text will clear it first. Does not affect normal toggle behavior.

preferences.name: enableSlashClearInFilter
preferences.label: Enable Clear Search key to clear filter text in Filter Mode
preferences.description: If enabled, typing the Clear Search key in Filter Mode when there is text will clear it first. Does not affect normal toggle behavior.

preferences.name: searchToggleModifier
preferences.title: Search • Filter Mode Toggle Modifier
preferences.description: Modifier for toggling search mode and clearing text

preferences.name: searchToggleKey
preferences.title: Search • Filter Mode Toggle Key
preferences.description: Key to toggle between Filter and Search modes (Default /)

preferences.name: titleBarContent
preferences.title: Title Bar: Show
preferences.description: What to show in the navigation title bar. 'Nothing' hides it completely, showing only the command name.

preferences.name: timeFormat
preferences.title: Title Bar: Time Format
preferences.description: Format string for the clock. Uses Intl.DateTimeFormat tokens. Examples: 'h:mm a' → 3:45 pm, 'HH:mm:ss' → 5:45:30, 'h:mm:ss a' → 3:45:30 PM. Only used when Title Bar is set to Clock.

preferences.name: autoRedirectBookmarks
preferences.label: Enable Bookmark Folder Redirection
preferences.title: Bookmarks: Auto Redirect
preferences.description: If enabled, opening bookmarks will automatically skip the root folder and go straight to the specified folder.

preferences.name: bookmarksRedirectFolder
preferences.title: Bookmarks: Redirect Folder Name
preferences.description: The name of the folder to automatically open (e.g. 'Bookmarks Bar', 'Favorites Bar', 'Favorites'). Case-insensitive.
